wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns.label: Wrapping, Sizing, and Flex Patterns
wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns.summary: Let navigation and content cards wrap when space is limited and give repeated content flexible base sizes.

sketch0.title: Wrapping lets items move onto another line

sketch1.title: A content row can wrap existing semantic cards

sketch2.title: The flex shorthand controls growth, shrink, and basis

try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.title: Try it yourself: Let the navigation wrap when space gets tight
try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.prompt:
**Problem**

The navigation works on wide screens, but its links can run out of horizontal room on narrower screens.

**Task**

Keep all existing CSS. Add `flex-wrap: wrap;` to `nav` so navigation items can move onto another flex line when needed.

try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.title: Try it yourself: Turn the main content into a wrapping flex row
try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.prompt:
**Problem**

The main content still stacks vertically, so the existing semantic cards cannot share a row and wrap naturally.

**Task**

Keep every previous rule. Give `main` `flex-direction: row;`, `flex-wrap: wrap;`, and `gap: 1.5rem;`.

try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.title: Try it yourself: Give the content cards a flexible starting size
try_wrapping_sizing_and_flex_patterns_sk.prompt:
**Problem**

The wrapping content cards can share rows, but they do not yet have a useful flexible basis for readable sizing.

**Task**

Keep the cumulative layout. Give `main > section, main > article` `flex: 1 1 18rem;`.

The Contact form still relies on normal document flow, so spacing between controls is harder to manage consistently.

Keep the navigation wrapping change. Make `form` a flex container with `display: flex;`, `flex-direction: column;`, and `gap: 0.75rem;`.
try-wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns-fo.hint: Give the form a vertical main axis and consistent flex gap.

help.concept: Flex wrapping lets nav items move to another line when needed, while a column flex form with `gap` creates consistent control spacing without extra markup.
help.hint_1: Apply wrapping to nav and use the existing form as a separate column flex container.
help.hint_2: Narrow the preview and open Contact: nav items should be able to wrap, and the form fields should form a clean vertical flex flow.

try-wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns-sk.title: Give the content cards a flexible starting size

The wrapping content cards can share rows, but they do not yet have a useful flexible basis for readable sizing.

Keep the cumulative layout. Give `main > section, main > article` `flex: 1 1 18rem;`.

try-wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns-na.title: Center navigation items on the cross axis
try-wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns-na.prompt:
**Problem**

The navigation can wrap, but its items are not explicitly aligned along the flex container's cross axis.

**Task**

Keep the flexible card basis. Add `align-items: center;` to `nav`.
try-wrapping-sizing-and-flex-patterns-na.hint: For a row flex container, cross-axis alignment is controlled with `align-items`.

help.concept: A flex basis gives the semantic cards a useful target `width`, while cross-axis alignment and a non-growing/non-shrinking link flex value stabilize the navigation.
help.hint_1: Use the existing main children as flex items, then finish the nav by controlling alignment and the links' flex behavior.
help.hint_2: Check wide and narrow previews: cards should resize and wrap from an 18rem basis, while nav links remain centered and keep their intrinsic `width`.
